Citizen · ref. CA0621-05L

Chandler

Field · 37–42mm · 100m · solar · 2010–2017

The Citizen Chandler is a family of military-inspired field watches known for their rugged simplicity and legible dials. Powered by Citizen's Eco-Drive technology, these watches are designed for everyday reliability and do not require battery changes.

The story

The Chandler collection, sometimes marketed as Garrison, emerged as part of Citizen's broader offering of Eco-Drive powered watches, which were introduced in 1996. This family of watches draws its design inspiration from classic military field watches, prioritizing functionality and a clean aesthetic. While a definitive launch date for the Chandler line is not formally documented, various models began appearing in the early 2010s. The collection has offered variations in size, dial color, and complications like chronographs, but has consistently maintained its core identity as a reliable and accessible field watch, evolving with gradual updates to its Eco-Drive calibers.
Fun fact · 3 of 6
The model's name is a historical term for a candle maker, a subtle reference to the light-powered Eco-Drive technology at its core. …
